from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper from the provided collection and its references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper, as written in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
